quest.title: Contraption-Contrived Cooking Course: Part I
quest.description: Cloud Retainer seems to have invented a new cooking device...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x20000, Recipe: Oncidium Tofu x1

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Good, good. These are the Bamboo Shoots that Ganyu prepared for oneself.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: The ingredients have all been prepared. Let us make ready to cook.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Mm... Perhaps this path is best...

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Ah, Traveler. Fine timing. Only recently has one finished setting this device up.

choices.text: So this is the Supreme Cuisine Machine?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Verily. Much personal work has one put into it, and its faculties are vast.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Much lore did one read in the construction of this cuisine-making machine. Know that there are a few key points in the art of "making food."

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: The first of these is finding ingredients, which are of utmost importance in cooking. Many long years have countless chefs labored and wandered in search of all manner of ingredients...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: One's device aims to solve this issue first of all.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Upon activation, it will automatically search for suitable ingredients nearby, and will mark their scent out, all the better for chefs to track them to their source.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Can't it go grab those ingredients by itself?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Ahem. This... Early days yet would one call this stage of work, and this issue of how a stove may trek across treacherous mountain roads by itself has yet to be resolved.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Now then, the second matter is the cooking itself. One has placed countless intricate components in this device's interior, such that the mere act of placing ingredients within will see them automatically processed.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How does it know how to do that?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Well... Naturally, it references the corresponding recipe in determining how the ingredients are to be processed.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Its inner workings are difficult to explain in a short time. You only need to know that resolving this matter took quite some work.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Much thought has one also bent to an affair most troubling for chefs — the cleaning of one's cooking utensils.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Quite a spoilage of a lovely scene of feasting it would be to have to clean up leftovers in the pot otherwise, no?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Haha, but one doubts you could afford this wondrous tool.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Moreover, it will only work under one's adeptal power at the moment. Purchasing it shall profit you nothing.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Alright, we have spoken idly long enough. Even as one was constructing this machine, one was also studying recipes.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Recipes too, therefore, has one developed alongside, such that this Supreme Cuisine Machine may face suitable trials.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: One invited you here to lend a little aid in gathering ingredients and following said recipes to make some dishes.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: The first of these one names the Oncidium Tofu.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: This dish requires tofu to be diced into tiny threads... a fair trial for this machine's knife-work.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: As to what the ingredients are... one shall require Tofu, Ham, Bamboo Shoots, and Fowl. One has already asked Ganyu to prepare those ingredients, and they should be...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: ...What? Where have the Bamboo Shoots gone? Most surely did one place them here. Did some villains take advantage of one's engrossed state to steal them away?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: ...Hmph. No matter. This is a good opportunity to show you the ingredient-finding faculties of one's Supreme Cuisine Machine.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Supreme Cuisine Machine... activate!

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Traveler, the machine has been activated. Follow the tracks it has created and reclaim one's Bamboo Shoots.

choices.text: Why did you make this device?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: One's motive? Why, to explore the arts of mechanisms and engineering, naturally.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: And of course, one's cooking will this render more convenient in the future...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Hmph, how hasty of you. Be at ease, and let one explain it to you.

talks.objective: Follow the aura trail and find the ingredients

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Have the Bamboo Shoots been reclaimed?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: One could not call the heat control desirable...

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: But no matter. One has ingredients to spare with which to attempt this once more.

talks.objective: Help Cloud Retainer complete the dish

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm ready.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Then let us begin.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Supreme Cuisine Machine... activate!

talks.objective: Help Cloud Retainer complete the dish

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Traveler, the machine has been activated. Follow the tracks it has created and reclaim one's Bamboo Shoots.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: The flames shall be yours to command, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Very good! Verily do the capabilities of this machine exceed the norm!

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: The fine control exercised in processing this Tofu... Indeed, one has outdone oneself.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: This is thanks to your aid as well, Traveler. Allow one to bestow a copy of the Oncidium Tofu recipe upon you.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: You may attempt to make it again, should time allow.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Further adjustments must one make to this machine's faculties...

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: One might still need your help. One trusts that you will not decline, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Then the rest can be left to this machine. However, Traveler, the heat control is yours to tend to.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can't this machine do that by itself?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Well... One has tried several times to use an internal flame in an attempt to achieve autonomous heat control...

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: But the flame on the Supreme Cuisine Machine's stove is far from ordinary. One must use one's own adeptal flame to operate it.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Adeptal flames of such power would warp the shape of the internal components if fed directly into the machine's interior. Sacrificing the larger machine for some small gain is thus unwise.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: The best solution at present is to apply the adeptal flames externally. As such, one requires a helper to control the heat of said flames...

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: The all-important flames shall be yours to command, Traveler. When you are ready, inform one at once.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: How is it? Is the Oncidium Tofu complete?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm not ready yet.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Hmm. Ready yourself, then, and inform one once it is so.
